name: Coverage Gap Reporter
description: Parse coverage outputs, map changed files to uncovered risk areas, and recommend targeted tests.

operational.approval_boundary: Safe for coverage analysis and recommendation; require human approval before modifying CI coverage gates.
operational.use_when: Use when coverage artifacts need to be mapped to changed files and uncovered regression risk.

limitations: Instruction package only; it does not provide or authorize an executable runtime capability.
usability.quickstart: Read SKILL.md and follow the documented workflow.
